title: Clustering in Three-Round Xoodoo Differential Trails
summary: Enumerated three-round Xoodoo trail cores show no clustering through weight 50, but whether higher-weight trails avoid clustering remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Do all three-round differential trails of Xoodoo avoid clustering, including trails of weight $w>50$?

scope.domain: Differential cryptanalysis of Xoodoo, focusing on clustering among three-round differential trails.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether three-round Xoodoo differential trails of weight above 50 avoid clustering.

progress.summary: The source conjectures that the negligible clustering observed for two-round Xoodoo differentials also holds for three rounds. The supplied context records verification for enumerated three-round trail cores only through weight 50.
citation_labels: Nicolas Bordes et al., Thinking Outside the Superbox
